units.source_text: “你觉得你现在是在什么地方？

en.t: Where do you think you are right now?

units.source_text: 你要是快点回话也就算了，如果顽固不化，本王立刻让你体会下地狱的刑罚是什么样子！”

en.t: If you answer quickly, that will be the end of it; but if you remain stubborn, this king will immediately make you learn what the punishments of hell are like!
